headline: HD Hyundai Vietnam Shipbuilding Constructs Dual-Fuel LNG Tanker with Wind Sails
summary: HD Hyundai Vietnam Shipbuilding initiated construction on a 115,000 DWT dual-fuel LNG LR2 oil tanker featuring rigid sail technology, advancing decarbonization efforts in commercial shipbuilding.
why: Adopting alternative propulsion and dual-fuel technology is crucial for shipbuilders seeking compliance with tighter global maritime emissions mandates.
